slides.title: Hi, I'm Mochi!
slides.body: I turn files into other files, and I make it feel easy. Let me show you around: it takes about two minutes.
bullets: Video, pictures, PDF, documents, audio, e-books, fonts and more
Everything converts on your own PC, nothing is uploaded
Free and open source
slides.tip: Use the Left and Right arrow keys, or press Esc to close.

slides.title: Drop your files here
slides.body: Home is the quiet way to start.
bullets: Drag files onto this box, or double-click it to choose files
Your results land next to the originals

slides.title: Pick what to do
slides.body: A preset is one ready-made job, like To PNG, To PDF or a video that fits Discord.
bullets: Choose a preset here, then drop your files
Finished files show under Recent conversions

slides.title: Or open the donut
slides.body: Pick files and a ring of tools opens around them, already filtered to what they can become.
bullets: Press Alt + D anywhere, or hold Shift while you drag files in Explorer
Click a slice, or drop the files on it
slides.tip: Tab, Space or the mouse wheel flips the donut over to the tools: annotate, PDF pages, remove background and more.

slides.title: Presets
slides.body: Decide what is on each donut.
bullets: Each kind of file has its own donut, with up to 8 slices on the front and the back
Switch a tool on to put it on the donut, and make your own presets

slides.title: Smart files
slides.body: Help with the files you already have. All of it runs on your computer.
bullets: Search by meaning: type "invoice from March" and find it by what it says
Tidy a messy folder: Mochi shows a plan first, and you can undo

slides.title: AI, if you want it
slides.body: Connect an AI and Mochi can read a file with you. This part is optional.
bullets: Summarise, ask a file questions, explain a picture, rename smartly
Your key is kept with Windows DPAPI, and nothing is sent until you run a tool

slides.title: Watch folders
slides.body: Set it up once and forget about it.
bullets: New files in a folder are converted into a 'converted' folder as they arrive
slides.tip: Mochi can keep running in the tray so Alt + D is always ready.

slides.title: Pick your toolbar
slides.body: The donut is one of five ways to pick a tool.
bullets: Donut, Quick Panel, Dock, Command Bar or Tile Pad
Change the shortcut and how see-through the donut is

slides.title: Make it cosy
slides.body: Mochi should feel nice to open.
bullets: 12 looks, light, dark or auto by time, accent colours, glass and spacing
Copy a whole look as one code and paste it on another PC

slides.title: Engines do the work
slides.body: Some conversions need a helper program, like FFmpeg for video or Ghostscript for PDF.
bullets: This page shows what is ready and what is missing
Install a missing engine with one click

slides.title: You're ready!
slides.body: Drop a file on Home to begin, or press Alt + D anywhere.
bullets: Open this tour again from the About page
Mochi is open source: ideas and bug reports are welcome on GitHub
slides.tip: Click a Mochi sticker and it squishes. They are friendly.
